name: update_goal
description: Update the exact revision of the current goal (call get_goal first and copy the goal_id and revision it returns verbatim). action is one of edit | pause | resume | complete | blocked. edit/pause/resume may only be called in turns initiated directly by a human; within the current automatic continuation round, complete and blocked are additionally allowed. blocked requires blocked_reason, and is mechanically rejected if the minimum number of consecutive rounds has not been reached.

goal_id.description: The exact goal_id returned by get_goal.

revision.description: The exact revision returned by get_goal (positive integer).

objective.description: The replacement goal text; only valid with action=edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: The replacement round cap; only valid with action=edit.

blocked_reason.description: The concrete blocking condition; required when action=blocked.
